policy.rule: Do not import until license_verdict is allow or allow_with_conditions and any conditions are met. needs_permission sources must not be bulk-copied. deny sources must not be used.

sources.name: Sanadset 650K (Data on Hadith Narrators)
sources.robots_txt_findings: N/A (Mendeley Data download, not a crawl target).
sources.rate_limit_plan: Local files after one download; no ongoing HTTP crawl.
sources.intended_use: Fill missing chains / chain_narrators ONLY where our book + hadith_number match Sanadset exactly. Do NOT auto-generate narrator aliases from this dataset.
sources.verdict_notes: Mendeley lists Licence CC BY 4.0. Attribution to Mghari, Bouras, El Hibaoui required. Scope narrowed per project approval: exact book+number chain fill only; no automatic alias generation.

sources.name: Hadith Transmitters Encyclopedia (Hawramani)
sources.license_name: No open-content licence published for bulk reuse
sources.robots_txt_findings: User-agent: * — Disallow /wp-admin/, login, feeds, search (?s=), author. Most biography paths are not disallowed. robots.txt permission to crawl ≠ licence to bulk-copy/redistribute.
sources.rate_limit_plan: N/A until permission granted. If later allowed: ≤1 req/s, cache raw HTML/JSON under data/collectors/raw/hawramani/.
sources.intended_use: Narrator biographies, jarh/taʿdīl snippets, teacher/student links.
sources.verdict_notes: Site ToS binds users to terms but does not grant a CC/open licence for bulk download or derivative databases. Classical source texts may be PD, but the compiled encyclopedia presentation is not clearly licensed for redistribution. Do not scrape for import.

sources.name: Muslim Scholars Database (Arees Institute)
sources.robots_txt_findings: HTTP 404 — no robots.txt published (checked 2026-10-19). Absence of robots.txt is not a licence to scrape.
sources.verdict_notes: Footer: Copyright (c) 2016-24 & beyond, Arees Institute — All Rights Reserved. Third-party Kaggle scrapes exist but are not authorization for us. Do not scrape or import those scrapes.

sources.name: fawazahmed0/hadith-api (editions + info.json)
sources.robots_txt_findings: N/A for GitHub raw/jsDelivr CDN of this repo.
sources.rate_limit_plan: Prefer mirrored CDN/GitHub raw; ≤2 req/s; cache under data/collectors/raw/hadith-api/.
sources.intended_use: Sunni book metadata (editions, info.json) and published grades in that API.
sources.verdict_notes: Repo LICENSE is Unlicense. Maintainer comments (issue #129) treat texts as public-domain under that licence. Condition: record provenance per edition file; do not treat unrelated Kaggle CC BY-NC mirrors as our licence source.

sources.name: Sunnah.com (website + API)
sources.license_name: Open platform; About §8 restricts scraping / mass reproduction
sources.robots_txt_findings: Prefer official API over HTML crawl. About §8: scraping and mass reproduction of entire books/collections not permitted; API snapshots OK; individual/selection reuse for teaching permitted.
sources.rate_limit_plan: Use sunnah.com API with key where required; ≤1–2 req/s; cache under data/collectors/raw/sunnah/; do not expand via HTML scrape.
sources.intended_use: Hadith texts/numbering/grades we already track; prefer API over site scrape for any new imports.
sources.verdict_notes: About §8 forbids scraping and mass reproduction of entire collections; directs users to the API for snapshots. Existing playwright-scrape:sunnah batches (3, 6; ~616 rows) came from HTML scrape → treat as needs_permission until re-imported via official API. Do not expand scrape imports.

sources.name: Encyclopedia of Translated Prophetic Hadiths (HadeethEnc)
sources.license_name: Publisher terms: republish translations with conditions (no modify + attribution)
sources.robots_txt_findings: Prefer official Downloads/API over ad-hoc scrape.
sources.rate_limit_plan: Prefer Excel/PDF downloads or Developers API; ≤1 req/s; cache under data/collectors/raw/hadeethenc/.
sources.intended_use: Translated hadith texts/grades for entries we already hold; store source_url + edition version.
sources.verdict_notes: Home Terms modal (AR): translations may be downloaded and re-published if (1) no modify/add/delete, (2) clear attribution to HadeethEnc.com, (3) cite edition version, (4) keep in-document translation version info, (5) report translation issues, (6) follow new source editions, (7) no unsuitable ads. Existing scrape imports should be reconciled to these conditions.

sources.name: Thaqalayn.net (website / public library)
sources.license_name: CC BY 4.0 (Stichting Thaqalayn public library content)
sources.robots_txt_findings: Allow / but Disallow: /api/ and /super/. Prefer thaqalayn-api.net for machine access; site HTML OK under CC BY with attribution.
sources.rate_limit_plan: Prefer thaqalayn-api.net; if using site, ≤1 req/s; cache under data/collectors/raw/thaqalayn/; attribute per terms.
sources.intended_use: Shia hadith texts/grades for books already in our DB, with CC BY attribution.
sources.verdict_notes: Terms (thaqalayn.com/terms): public library content including translations CC BY 4.0 — copy/share/adapt including commercially with attribution. Do not imply endorsement. Prefer API sibling source thaqalayn-api for bulk.

sources.name: thaqalayn-api.net (MohammedArab1/ThaqalaynAPI)
sources.license_name: API software GPL-3.0; Thaqalayn public library content CC BY 4.0
sources.robots_txt_findings: thaqalayn.net: Allow / but Disallow: /api/ and /super/. Use thaqalayn-api.net endpoints, not the site's Disallow /api/ paths.
sources.rate_limit_plan: ≤1 req/s to thaqalayn-api.net; cache JSON under data/collectors/raw/thaqalayn-api/; only books we already track.
sources.intended_use: Shia hadith texts/grades (e.g. Majlisi/Behbudi) for books already in our DB.
sources.verdict_notes: Stichting Thaqalayn licenses public library content CC BY 4.0 with attribution. Attribute Thaqalayn + link + note changes. Prefer REST/GQL API over scraping thaqalayn.net.

sources.name: Dorar.net (الدرر السنية) website
sources.robots_txt_findings: User-agent: * Disallow: (empty) — crawl not blocked by robots, but API/site Terms override for data use.
sources.rate_limit_plan: N/A for bulk until official token + research-archive approval. Do not expand local dorar scrapes.
sources.intended_use: Hadith-level gradings for variations we already hold — only after official approval.
sources.verdict_notes: Terms forbid scraping/bulk download/full-database storage and sub-licensing. Existing playwright-scrape:dorar imports (~17 variations) are under this verdict — candidate for unpublish pending decision.

sources.name: Dorar (الدرر السنية) official Hadith API
sources.robots_txt_findings: User-agent: * Disallow: (empty) — crawl not blocked by robots, but API Terms override for data use.
sources.rate_limit_plan: Official: 60 requests/minute per token. Cache responses max 24–48 hours per Terms — conflicts with permanent DB storage unless Dorar approves our research archive use.
sources.intended_use: Hadith-level gradings for variations we already hold (display + provenance), not a full encyclopedia dump.
sources.verdict_notes: Terms forbid scraping/bulk download/full-database storage, sub-licensing, and require attribution + clickable source URL. Permanent import into our Postgres with indefinite retention is not clearly allowed by the 24–48h cache rule. Apply for a token stating research/archive purpose; until approved, do not bulk-import.

sources.name: AhmedElTabarani/dorar-hadith-api (unofficial wrapper)
sources.license_name: Wrapper code open; underlying Dorar content proprietary
sources.robots_txt_findings: Same as Dorar site; Terms still forbid bulk scrape/storage.
sources.intended_use: None — listed only to document rejection.
sources.verdict_notes: Proxies Dorar search HTML/API and would violate Dorar bulk/scrape/storage rules if used to fill our DB. Prefer official Dorar API after permission.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.robots_txt_findings: Use Query Service / API with User-Agent; respect WMF rate guidance.
sources.rate_limit_plan: SPARQL ≤1 heavy query / few seconds; User-Agent identifying project; cache under data/collectors/raw/wikidata/.
sources.intended_use: Scholars, imams, compilers first: names, kunya/laqab where present, birth/death, madhhab. Then narrator exact-label enrichment where matched.
sources.verdict_notes: Structured data in main namespaces is CC0. Do not invent missing properties; leave NULL.

sources.name: Wikipedia (en/ar biographical articles)
sources.robots_txt_findings: Use official MediaWiki API / REST; do not aggressive-crawl HTML.
sources.rate_limit_plan: MediaWiki API with User-Agent; ≤1–2 req/s; cache under data/collectors/raw/wikipedia/.
sources.intended_use: Supplement Wikidata for scholars/imams when a field is cited on-wiki; store source_url to revision.
sources.verdict_notes: Attribution + ShareAlike for Wikipedia text excerpts. Prefer structured Wikidata facts over copying prose.

sources.name: OpenITI (Open Islamicate Texts Initiative)
sources.rate_limit_plan: Paused — do not download or process until commercial-use status of this app is confirmed.
sources.intended_use: Paused. If later confirmed non-commercial: locate open digital texts of rijāl works for quoted rulings — only where specific OpenITI file URI exists.
sources.verdict_notes: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. On hold until we confirm whether the app is commercial. Do not use OpenITI collectors until user confirms.

summary.next_step_after_approval: Step 2: Wikidata scholars/imams first (allow); then narrator exact-label coverage. Sanadset later for exact book+number missing chains only. OpenITI blocked until commercial clarified.
